description: Quote moving funds from another network (ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, bnb, polygon and others, 15 in all, or a chain ID) to an agent wallet on Robinhood Chain, arriving as ETH. `payer` is the wallet that already holds the funds on the origin network: if the user did not name it, ask, do not reuse `wallet`. `amount` is in the smallest unit (wei for ETH), a number or a string of digits. Returns transactions for the payer to sign. The answer also has sign_url: a keyfo page where the user checks the transaction and signs it in their own wallet. It stays open for 15 minutes and gets a new quote itself when the price is out of date. Show that link to the user, and never ask them to paste the transaction data anywhere.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of what you pay with, like wei for ETH.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: Token address to pay with on the origin network. Empty pays in its native coin.
currency.title: Currency

origin_chain.description: Network to pay from: a name, like base, or its chain ID, like 8453.
origin_chain.title: Origin Chain

payer.description: Wallet that pays on the origin network and signs there. It must hold the funds there, so it is usually not the agent wallet: ask the user for it, do not copy `wallet`.
payer.title: Payer

wallet.description: Agent wallet on Robinhood Chain that receives the ETH.
wallet.title: Wallet

name: fund_agent
title: Fund agent wallet
